note: Values are Dairy Queen's official U.S. nutrition figures from dairyqueen.com, checked on September 25, 2026. Confirm current figures with Dairy Queen, especially for allergies or medical diets.

meta.source_name: Dairy Queen Nutrition and Allergen Information (U.S.)
meta.values_origin: Every item was checked on 2026-10-25 against the Food & Treats nutrition table on dairyqueen.com (the page states the information is current as of August 26, 2024). Local Favorites are sold only at some locations.
meta.serving_basis: One standard menu serving as named, standard recipe, no customizations unless listed as an add-on.
meta.addon_macros: Add-ons (bacon, extra patty, mayo, Swiss cheese, dipping sauces and malt) use Dairy Queen's published nutrition for each add-on, so all values are included in totals.

changelog.change: Added provenance metadata (market, official reference, review status). Nutrition values unchanged.

Full review against the official U.S. source listed above. All values replaced with official figures; items no longer on the official U.S. menu or not published by the restaurant were removed or replaced with the official equivalent; add-ons without official values were removed. Removed/replaced ids: bacon-cheeseburger-quarter, original-basket-fries-small, vanilla-blizzard-small. New ids: bacon-two-cheese-deluxe-double, fries-regular.

Added items from dairyqueen.com's official nutrition table. New ids: oreo-blizzard-mini, oreo-blizzard-large, reeses-blizzard-mini, reeses-blizzard-small, reeses-blizzard-medium, reeses-blizzard-large, chicken-strip-basket-6, chicken-strips-3, fries-kids, fries-large, vanilla-cone-large.

Full re-check against dairyqueen.com Food & Treats (current as of August 26, 2024). All existing values matched. Added saturated fat, sugar and fiber to every item, official add-ons (bacon, extra patty, mayo, Swiss cheese, dipping sauces, malt), and the rest of the menu: all Blizzard flavors and sizes, all Stackburgers and hamburgers, chicken sandwiches and sauced baskets, hot dogs, sides, kids items, regional Local Favorites, shakes, sundaes, cones, MooLattes, Misty drinks, smoothies and Orange Julius. Parmesan Garlic 4 pc basket left out (its row is misaligned on the official page); Flamethrower limited-time items match the Spicy Chicken Strip Sandwich and baskets, so they are not listed twice.
